razorpay.subject: Strategic Infrastructure for Razorpay's IPO Path
razorpay.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I saw the recent news about Razorpay's secondary round and the clear signal towards your IPO trajectory. As you scale your neo-banking and payroll verticals, infrastructure reliability becomes non-negotiable.

Blostem has been monitoring your expansion, and I'd love to show you how we can automate your cross-border settlement reconciliation. Are you free for a 10-minute sync next Tuesday?

razorpay.subject: Quick follow-up: Settlement speeds
razorpay.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Following up on my previous note. Most growth-stage fintechs at your scale face 3-4% slippage in manual reconciliation during high-volume product launches.

Would love to share our benchmark data on how Slice optimized this. Worth a chat?

razorpay.subject: Our technical deep-review on Razorpay
razorpay.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Our team just finished a deep review of Razorpay's public API infrastructure. We've identified three specific areas where our settlement engine can reduce latency by 40%.

Open to a brief walk-through of the findings?

slice.subject: Supporting Slice's 'Reserve' Launch
slice.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Congrats on the launch of Slice Reserve! Capturing the Gen-Z credit market requires incredible backend agility.

We specialize in high-concurrency ledger systems for consumer lending. I'd love to discuss how we can support your new credit line's volume.
